name: Fernando Pailhe
summary: At my core, I'm a creator, driven by the joy of building and solving challenges. As a Mobile App Developer with over five years of experience, I specialize in React Native, Kotlin, and TypeScript. I currently serve as a Developer and Functional Analyst for Techint's internal mobile app, focused on team management. I previously led development for Be Soul, re-architecting the app with Redux and SOLID principles for scalability. My quick learning and adaptability have been key to tackling both front & back-end tasks, while my background in Audio Visual Design optimizes solutions for a better UX
